description:
Draw the invoice-design card so the USER picks the layout an invoice prints in and sets what it prints: the ink, the language, whether a customer-portal address is printed, and which note, tax rate and payment means back the payment-terms, tax-regime, legal-mentions and payment-means rows.

REQUIRED: invoice_id, or template_build_id for the capture mode below. Never both.

Every field's options are read off this workspace's OWN records — its notes, its tax rates, its payment means — never a fixture. The payment-means field's `mint` verdict on each option is the REAL capability read off `workspace_connectors.installed_capabilities`, never a guess from a connector's name: a connector can be fully connected and still refuse, and the verdict names the registry reason (no committed tool, not installed, capability capture never ran, or installed without the minting scope).

Draws the card and waits for the user's "Use this design", which calls `well_update_invoice_design`. Do not read this and then decide whether to draw — drawing IS the step.

customer_id: the invoice's customer, for saving their default design.

CAPTURE MODE: pass template_build_id instead of invoice_id, the enrichment_task_id that well_create_invoice_template or well_create_invoice_template_revision returned. On a host that draws cards, the card waits for the build and then shows the dropped invoice beside the rebuilt design, with the logo and the legal mentions it would reuse, each one kept or removed by the person, and Keep, Ask for changes and Not now. The card asks for its two pictures itself and gets them in the result's _meta, which the host hands to the card, not to you. Keep saves the design itself through well_create_workspace_invoice_design. A host that draws no card cannot show the rebuilt design, and no link opens it: reference_url opens the dropped invoice, never the design. The result's capture says where the build stands (building, built, not_built), what the design would reuse (offer) and the link to the dropped invoice (reference_url). Draw it once, right after the build starts, and end the turn: the card follows the build by itself. Leave include_pictures unset: the card asks for its pictures.

conversation_id.description: The conversation id returned by the previous Well result, in its meta under well/conversation_id, in its structuredContent, or in its JSON text block. Pass it back on every call in the same conversation, including a call a card makes, so the chosen workspace and the earlier answers still apply. It decides the conversation on its own: nothing the host states about the session replaces it. Omit it only on the first call of a conversation.

include_pictures.description: Set by the capture card to draw its two pictures. The pictures reach the card only, never your copy of the result; leave unset.

invoice_id.description: The UUID of the invoice whose design to draw.

template_build_id.description: Capture mode: the enrichment_task_id of the build that rebuilt a design from a dropped invoice. Replaces invoice_id.

workspace_id.description: Target workspace. Omit when the token authorizes one workspace. Required when it authorizes several: this read reports one workspace's own figures and will not choose which.

name: well_show_invoice_design

capture.description: Capture mode only: the build, the design it rebuilt and what the design would reuse.

issuer_name.description: The company that issued the dropped invoice, as the page names it.

legal_mentions.description: The legal mentions printed on the dropped invoice, or null.

legal_mentions_unverified.description: True when the invoice is not the workspace's own and the reading found no mentions on it.

logo_present.description: Whether a logo was cut from the dropped invoice.

starts_kept.description: Whether the logo and the mentions start as kept: only for the workspace's own invoice.

pictures.description: The two pictures, only when Well's chat card asked for them. An MCP host gets them in _meta instead.

reference_document_id.description: The dropped invoice the design was rebuilt from.

reference_url.description: A link that opens the dropped invoice in Well, for a host that draws no card.

review_status.description: approved once the person kept the template.

revises_template_id.description: The template this revision replaces once kept; null for a first build.

state.description: building: still running. built: a template to show. not_built: ended with none.

template_document_id.description: The built template, once the build stored one.

conversation_id.description: The conversation this result belongs to. Pass it back as the conversation_id argument on every later Well call in the same conversation.

conversation_id_note.description: Present only when the server opened a fresh lane, stating that no choice recorded earlier was read.

conversation_id_source.description: Where the conversation id came from: the host's own request meta, the caller's argument, or a fresh lane the server opened.

customer_id.description: The invoice's customer, for saving their default design.

thumbnail_url.description: A picture of the design's first page; null when the design has none.

tier.description: Official designs ship with Well; every other design is a community layout.

settings.description: The design the card opens on, under the design_* names: each setting the invoice saved, else the customer's saved design, else the last invoice designed for this customer, else the house design, else the default.

newly_connected.description: Tools that connected to this workspace since the last result and that no session was told about yet, oldest first. Present only when at least one tool is new. Start the reply with one line per entry, in the person's language: "<name> is connected.". Never fold several entries into one sentence. Each entry comes back once, on one result only: never repeat its line later.

refusal_reason.description: The WellError code when the read is refused.

resolved_workspace.description: The workspace that answered, when the caller named none and the token authorizes several.

title: Show invoice design
